title: Generate Parentheses
kidExplanation: How many ways can you write n pairs of parentheses that always stay correctly nested?
plainProblem: LeetCode 22: Generate Parentheses. Restate the official prompt in your own words, list inputs and outputs, then solve a tiny example by hand before coding.

thinkingSteps.title: Brute force idea
thinkingSteps.body: For Generate Parentheses, first describe a slow but correct approach (often nested loops or rescanning).

thinkingSteps.title: Why it is slow
thinkingSteps.body: Count the loops. If work looks like n×n, say so. Google interviewers want that honesty.

thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: To generate all valid combinations of parentheses, we can use backtracking. We start with an empty string and two counters, one for the open parentheses and one for the close parentheses. At each step, we have two choices: add an open parenthesis if the count of open parentheses is less than the total number of pairs, or add a close parenthesis if the count of close parentheses is less than the count of open parentheses. We continue this process recursively until we reach the desired length of the string. If the string becomes valid, we add it to the result.
